I genuinely don’t think I can put into words how much Andre and Unleash’d K9 changed my life.

When I first got Parcero, I loved him more than anything, but I was overwhelmed. He’s a big, strong, extremely energetic dog, and although he has never been aggressive, his reactivity was really difficult for me to manage. He would pull HARD on walks, bark and react when he saw other dogs, jump, get anxious in new environments, and overall I felt like I was constantly trying to control a situation instead of actually enjoying my dog. Traveling with him or imagining taking him calmly to restaurants, stores, parks, or busy places felt almost impossible.

On top of that, I have a medical condition that makes it especially important for me to have a dog I can safely and confidently handle. I didn’t want Parcero to become a “robot.” I wanted him to still be the goofy, playful, loving dog I fell in love with — I just needed us to understand each other.

That is exactly what Andre gave us.

After Parcero’s training with Andre, I genuinely felt like I got the same dog back, but with an entirely new relationship between us. Andre didn’t just train Parcero; he taught ME how to communicate with him, how to lead him, how to understand his behavior, and how to give him structure without taking away his personality.

The difference has been incredible. Things that used to make me anxious — walking past other dogs, being in busy public places, asking him to settle for long periods of time, traveling with him — became things I finally felt capable of handling. I was able to fly across the country with Parcero in the cabin with me, something that once felt completely unrealistic considering how reactive and anxious he used to be.

But what makes Andre so special goes beyond the results. You can tell how much he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with. He was patient with Parcero, but he was also incredibly patient with ME. He answered my million questions, explained the “why” behind what we were doing, and made sure I understood that training doesn’t end when your dog comes home. He gave me the tools and confidence to continue the work myself.

As someone who needed Parcero to become a calm, reliable companion while still being PARCERO, I could not have asked for a better trainer.

This experience genuinely changed my day-to-day life. I went from feeling overwhelmed and sometimes wondering how I was ever going to manage such a strong, reactive dog, to feeling proud walking beside him and excited about all of the places and experiences we can share together.

If you’re considering Unleash’d K9, especially if you have a reactive, anxious, strong, or high-energy dog, I cannot recommend Andre enough. The investment wasn’t just in Parcero’s training — it was in our relationship and in the life I’m able to have with him now.

Andre, thank you for believing in Parcero, for teaching me how to be the owner he needed, and most importantly, for never trying to change who he is. You truly changed both of our lives.

Forever grateful to Andre and Unleash’d K9!!!!

Andres worked with our dog Obi while I was pregnant and one of my biggest concerns was how Obi would adjust to having a baby in the house. I honestly couldn’t be happier with how amazing he is with our son. He knows to keep a little distance until he’s invited over and if we ask him to step away he listens immediately. He’s so well behaved around the baby and day to day. We did not have an easy dog. Obi had a lot of anxiety and Andres worked extremely hard with him to help build his confidence. I truly credit everything to how hard Andres worked with him. We are so grateful!

We started 1:1 training with Andre because our dog was very hyperactive on walks and a bit reactive (not aggressively). She could ignore a person without a problem, but the second she saw a dog or cat, she would start lunging, and it was really hard to get her to calm down.

For most of the four years we’ve had her, going on walks honestly made us nervous. I personally didn’t feel comfortable taking her out by myself, and we were turned off by the idea of going to parks or just having her out and about with us.

Through training with Andre, I was really surprised by how, little by little, we were able to expose her to different environments and help her experience more of the world. My goal was never to take her to restaurants or have her go everywhere with us, but I didn’t want her to be a dog that stayed in the house all the time and I feel we have achieved it.

One of our biggest goals was also being able to take her to the vet without feeling like we were walking in with a tornado. Anddd I can happily say we did it. While she wasn’t 100% perfect, because after all, she’s a dog and not a robot, she did amazing! Even the staff commented on how well she did, which felt like a huge win for us.

We also introduced a cat into our household, and the training helped us start working on her routine and how to manage everything. It also helped us get her moving more and work on her losing weight, which was something we had been thinking about for a long time but didn’t know how to approach.

Now I can personally take her outside by myself without feeling like it’s the end of the world. I know she still needs more exposure and consistency, and that’s something I’m going to continue working on with her.

I really appreciate all the support Andre gave us, and I hope to come back in the future to work on other things so she can continue having more fun and experiencing more of the world with us.

Andre’s training and professionally were fantastic. I have highly recommended to all my friends in the market for training and have since returned for his boarded training when I am out of town. My dog is very high energy, and Andre was able to give a regiment following his training that has not only honed in her behavior but has left everyone complimenting how well behaved she is. Incredible service, great guy to work with, and will be returning again.

We’ve had such a great experience with Andre and truly trust him with Brooke. As a rescue, Brooke came to us with some anxiety and reactivity, and finding someone who understood her personality while still giving her the structure she needed was really important to us. Andre has been incredibly patient with her, and it’s been amazing watching how much more confident, calm, and responsive she has become since working with him. He also does a great job of explaining the “why” behind what he’s doing, which has helped us become better and more consistent with her at home. We’ve continued to use him for boarding, and Brooke is always genuinely excited to see him, which says a lot about the relationship he’s built with her. It gives me so much peace of mind knowing she’s with someone who knows her quirks, understands her boundaries, and genuinely cares about her. I would absolutely recommend Andre to anyone looking for someone they can trust with their dog, whether it’s for training or boarding.

My GF and I absolutely love Andre and can’t recommend him enough! Brooke is a shelter dog who came to us with some challenging behaviors, especially pulling constantly on walks and being reactive at times. We did Andre’s four-week basic training program, and the difference has been incredible. She now walks calmly without pulling and is much more responsive to us overall. What really sets Andre apart is that he didn’t just train Brooke, he taught us how to communicate with her, understand her behavior, and consistently reinforce the good habits she learned. We also use Andre frequently for boarding and have complete confidence leaving her with someone who understands her personality, boundaries, and needs. Brooke absolutely loves him, and having someone we trust this much for both training and boarding has been invaluable.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I highly recommend Unleash’d K9. He is extremely professional, understanding, reliable, and you can tell he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with. Mila has always been in great hands with him.

What really stood out to me was one time I had to travel unexpectedly and called him at the very last minute. Without hesitation, he went completely out of his way to come to my house and pick up Mila for me. That kind of flexibility and willingness to help is hard to find and meant a lot to me.

I feel completely comfortable trusting him with Mila, and that alone says everything. Great service and someone I would absolutely recommend to anyone looking for a trainer they can trust.

Nicole, one of my clients, always brings her dog Thelma to Vanity Projects, and I was amazed by how calm, obedient, and well-behaved she was. When she told me about Unleashd K9, she said it was the best investment she had ever made for her dog—and she couldn’t have been more right.

My one-year-old Standard Poodle, Benson, and my four-year-old rescue, Lilabet (a Staffordshire/Schnauzer Terrier mix), had never received leash training and struggled with impulse control. I wanted to be able to walk them confidently, travel with them, and even bring them to work, but it simply wasn’t possible.

I enrolled Benson in the month-long intensive program and Lilabet in the two-week program so they could learn together. Watching Andre’s training updates on Instagram, I was amazed at how quickly they responded to his guidance and socialization.

The difference when they came home was immediate. Walks are now enjoyable instead of stressful, and the commands Andre taught them have completely changed how we interact.

What truly sets Unleashd K9 apart are the follow-up sessions after the dogs return home. Andre doesn’t just train the dogs, he trains the owners. These sessions taught me how to be more consistent and confident, making it much easier to reinforce everything they learned.

The transformation has been remarkable, and I can’t recommend Andre and Unleashd K9 highly enough. I’m incredibly grateful for the tools and confidence they’ve given me, and I’m excited to continue building on this foundation so my family and our dogs can enjoy many happy years together.
Very well rounded with commands and training procedures, always polite yet honest.  Definitely recommend 👌

Training Nina was one of the best decisions I made! She’s a Yorkie with a big personality, and the transformation has been incredible. She’s much more obedient, confident, and well-behaved, and it’s made our daily life so much easier. What I appreciated most was the patience, professionalism, and genuine care shown throughout the entire process. It was clear that Nina was treated with kindness and that her individual personality was always respected.

I highly recommend this training service to anyone looking for real results and someone who truly cares about dogs. Thank you Andre for everything you’ve done for Nina!

I can’t say enough good things about Andre. Rio absolutely loves him, and the difference I’ve seen since they started working together has been incredible. It’s not just about obedience—it’s about building confidence, creating structure, and understanding your dog better. Honestly, I think Andre has spent just as much time training me to be a better dog owner as he has training Rio. 😊

When I travel for work, Rio stays with Andre, and I never have to worry. He loves playing with the other dogs, getting on the treadmill, and swimming in the pool. Every time I pick him up, he’s happy, healthy, clean, and completely exhausted from having so much fun.

What I appreciate most is that Andre has found the perfect balance between discipline and play. Rio is safe, challenged, well cared for, and genuinely excited every time he sees him. Knowing he’s in that kind of environment gives me complete peace of mind when I’m away.

I couldn’t recommend Andre more highly.

From dangerous chaos to perfect harmony - André is a miracle worker.
f you are struggling with severe dog behavior issues and feel like you have tried everything, do yourself a favor and call André at Unleash'd K9 right now. My only regret is not finding him sooner.
The Nightmare Before Unleash'd K9
Three months ago, my home was in complete chaos. I have two powerful boys who are a mix of Rhodesian Ridgeback, Pitbull, and Beagle. Despite my lifelong experience owning many dogs—including living on a farm—I was completely at a loss.
Dangerous Car Rides: My dogs would fight viciously in the backseat. It was terrifying and unsafe; I easily could have crashed or been bitten trying to break them up.
In-Home Aggression: They were fighting inside the house. One dog was constantly setting his own boundaries using his mouth and air-snapping. My home was micro-managed with barriers just to keep them separated and off the furniture.
Stressful Walks: One dog was incredibly reactive to other dogs on and off-leash. Walks were a nightmare. Passing a yard with a barking dog was completely impossible due to a total lack of impulse control.
The Failed "Expert" Advice
Before finding André, I took my boys to two other dog trainers. Their only solutions were to put my dogs on medication and refer us to a dog psychiatrist. I knew in my gut that putting them on meds for no reason wasn’t the answer.
The André Difference
From day one, André’s experience working with hundreds of dogs shined through. Just like me, he knew they didn’t need medication—they needed real leadership and structure.
Over the course of 10 sessions, André completely transformed our lives:
True Professionalism: André is a professional in every sense of the word. He is incredibly generous with his time and input. I never once felt rushed during a session, and his genuine care for the dogs is obvious.
Human Training: He didn’t just train the dogs; he completely overhauled my handling techniques and taught me how to communicate effectively with my boys.
Mind-Blowing Impulse Control: My dogs now have a rock-solid "down-wait" that they will not break. We can walk right past major distractions and barking dogs, and they don't pay them any attention
Life Today
After completing our 10-session program, I have completely reclaimed my house, my furniture, and my peace of mind. All the indoor barriers are gone. The dogs are fundamentally calmer, and there are absolutely zero fights in the house, the car, or out in public.
I can now take my boys absolutely anywhere. They are so well-behaved that we actually get invited back to places we visit.  We can’t wait to start group classes. André gave me my life back and saved my dogs. I cannot recommend Unleash'd K9 highly enough!

We completed the 4-week private training program and have done several group trainings with Andre for our 1.5-year-old Golden Retriever, Jettie, and we can't recommend Unleash'd K9 enough.

Before training, Jettie didn't know how to settle at home, and walks were stressful because he pulled on the leash and barked at other dogs.

What made the biggest difference wasn't that he just taught Jettie commands, but that he helped us implement the right structure at home. We've tried other training programs before, but nothing worked like this.

The change was almost immediate. Jettie finally learned how to relax and simply do nothing. He's calmer, more focused, and so much easier to live with. Our walks are now enjoyable, and friends and family constantly comment on how much his behavior has changed. Jettie loved every training session and had so much fun working with Andre.

We're so grateful for Andre's guidance and practical approach. It truly transformed our day-to-day life with Jettie, and we couldn't be happier. If you're considering training, we highly recommend Unleash'd K9!

Andres is extremely communicative, professional, and knowledgeable. He kept us informed throughout the process and clearly cares about the dogs he works with. We would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a trainer

Highly recommend to anyone looking for real results and a positive training experience!

You can tell they truly care about the dogs and their well-being, not just about “training” them.

I 100% recommend them to anyone looking for real results. Worth every penny

When I met Andre, not only he earned my trust quickly, he earned Kilo’s trust. Something I noticed Andre did that other trainers didn’t do was explain that he uses “Play” as a training method. Seeing how he interacts with all his client’s and personal dogs put me at ease. After I had such a great experience with Andre, I boarded Kilo with him multiple times when I had to travel as well as referring him to two of my friends who have working breed dogs (GSD and Doberman). My friends also had a great experience with Andre and still repeatedly use his services.

10/10 recommend. I’d say this is the best dog trainer in South Florida.

We sent our energetic chocolate lab to Unleash’d K9’s boarding and obedience program, and we couldn’t be happier with the results! After just a few weeks, we saw remarkable improvement — his recall is now reliable, walks are stress-free, and he’s much calmer and better behaved at home. We’ve already recommended them to several friends and will definitely be back for future boarding needs!

The dog whisperer! For real! Absolutely amazing experience! Andre was professional, patient, and truly cares about the dogs. I saw incredible results in a short time, and the training made a huge difference in mine and my furbaby’s daily life. Highly recommend to anyone looking for real results!

Absolute best K9 trainer I’ve come across! Not only did Andre teach my German shepherd obedience, he also taught me how to be a proper handler to my dog. There’s no else I trust with my dog more than Andre. Highly recommend!

I contacted Andre because my two dachshund puppies were very small and misbehaved. Thanks to him, I can now rest easy because they obey all commands. I can even take them for walks... highly recommended!

Initially reached out for 2 reasons, 1. We were looking to board our husky due to travel 2. She was also scared of rain/thunder and after speaking with Andre we discovered that she could really use his training techniques. From the very beginning communication was professional, thoughtful and genuinely caring.  Unfortunately before we could move forward, we had to put her a sleep. While we didn’t get the chance to use the training services, the kindness and responsiveness we experienced left a strong impression. Based on that alone, we would have felt confident moving forward and would recommend others to consider reaching out.

After my 1st dog passed away due to an unexpected “mishap” during a dental cleaning at Banfield (watch out), I decided to buy my dream dog, a beautiful blue purebred European Doberman I named, Klaus.
I’ve done tons of research on the breed and as a mother of three rescue puppies (including a malinois/german sheppard mix), I was confident I could break any dog. However, I was MISTAKEN Klaus tested me in every way possible to the point I decided I needed HELP if I wanted to keep him, which for me was not an option, he was my baby already.
I started looking for trainers online but it’s so hard to find a good one when there’s sooooo many, but one day, out of the blue, I took Klaus out on a potty break and I saw one of my neighbors (that owned a well behaved giant dog) talking to a man in front of a black truck with the words Unleashk9 stamped accross it.
I watched them from afar to see what this was about and I saw it was some kind of training session. Next time I saw my neighbor I asked him all about it and that’s how I got to Andre. After a short conversation to measure Klaus’ needs, Andre accepted to take him for a beginners training session (2 weeks), those two weeks felt like a vacation to me but to Klaus, IT WAS WORK!
After the two weeks had passed, Klaus came back to me able to stay in place, he would listen, he wouldn’t pull on his leash, and even though he still makes mistakes I now have the tools to correct him because he learned to listen to certain words like “place” “no” “enough” “off” etc.
I think the most important thing in cohabitating with a dog is just to have them LISTEN to you, even for their own safety and this was one of the biggest things Andre has helped me with!

I gave him a bad kid and he returned to me a well behaved teenager, still a teenager! But we now have the tools to work with him as a family ❤️ THANK YOU ANDRE!

We hired Unleash’d K9 for private sessions because our dog had no manners, no boundaries, and no rules in the house. He was doing whatever he wanted and we were frustrated. Andre helped us put structure in place, taught us how to hold our dog accountable, and showed us how to create a calm home. Now our dog has much better obedience, respects thresholds, understands boundaries, and is much easier to live with. These sessions helped both us and our dog. Highly recommend.

We did the 4-week Board & Train with Unleash’d K9 for our dog’s separation anxiety, and the transformation was huge. Before training, our dogs were extremely anxious anytime we left the house. They would cry, pace, get worked up, and could not settle down on their own. It was stressful for them and stressful for us.

After the program, they came back like a different dogs. They are much calmer, more confident, crate trained, and able to relax without constantly depending on us. Andre gave them structure, obedience, and clear expectations, and that changed everything. They now understands how to settle, follow rules, and exist calmly in the house.

What stood out most was that this was not just random obedience. They actually fixed the root of the problem. Our dogs are now more stable, more relaxed, and much easier to live with. I highly recommend Unleash’d K9 if your dog struggles with anxiety or separation issues.

Andre at Unleash’d K9 completely changed my dog in just four weeks. Before training, my dog was extremely anxious, nervous, and had bad separation anxiety. Walks were stressful because he pulled so hard that I could barely handle him for 10 minutes without my arms hurting.

After working with Andre, my dog is so much calmer, more confident, and much easier to live with. He now has solid obedience and basic manners, is crate trained, no longer struggles with separation anxiety, walks right next to me on leash without pulling, doesn’t jump on people, and has a great recall. On top of that, he’s much friendlier and more relaxed overall.

The biggest difference is that walks are actually enjoyable now. I can walk him for an hour with no stress. I highly recommend Unleash’d K9 to anyone who needs real results with their dog.
